blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (camelCase renames every existing order JSON field) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (Existing config.toml files fail to load without default_currency) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub order_id: i64,
    pub customer_id: i64,
    pub total_cents: i64,
findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so the existing fields keep their snake_case names (`order_id`, `customer_id`, `total_cents`) and only `currency` is added. Today `GET /orders/{id}` returns `orderId`, `customerId` and `totalCents` instead: every partner integration that reads `order_id`, `customer_id` or `total_cents` gets a missing field on the first response after deploy, with no **BREAKING** item in the release note (which only says "Added: Orders carry their `currency`") and in breach of docs/api.md's promise of two releases of deprecation before any rename. Add a test that serializes an `OrderResponse` and asserts the exact keys.
findings.title: camelCase renames every existing order JSON field

findings.evidence:
/// The currency of orders that do not name one (ISO 4217).
pub default_currency: String,
findings.recommendation: Give the new key a default, e.g. `#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning `"EUR"` (the currency the shop sold in before this change), and test that a config holding only `database_url` and `listen` still loads. As written the field is required: every deployed `config.toml`, which holds only `database_url` and `listen` like the previous config.example.toml, makes `load` return a `missing field `default_currency`` error and the service no longer starts after the upgrade. Nothing in the release note tells operators to add the key; if a default is not wanted, mark it **BREAKING** with the manual step.
findings.title: Existing config.toml files fail to load without default_currency
